jobgether-jobgether:lever:f4d7923a-028a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Design Engineer - MetaMask based in United Kingdom. This is an opportunity for a senior frontend-focused engineer to shape intuitive, polished experiences used by millions of people interacting with Web3 products. You’ll work at the intersection of engineering, product, and design, turning complex user flows into fast, accessible, and delightful interfaces. The role combines hands-on development with a strong focus on interaction design, animation, micro-interactions, and visual craftsmanship. You’ll contribute across React and React Native while helping evolve scalable design systems and cross-platform frontend patterns. You’ll also explore AI-assisted and agentic engineering workflows that accelerate design-to-code execution without compromising quality. Working with a globally distributed team, you’ll have significant autonomy while collaborating closely with designers, engineers, and product leaders. Your work will directly influence products and experiences used by a large, global community of Web3 users. Build pixel-perfect, production-ready interfaces using React and React Native, maintaining a high standard of visual and functional quality. Translate Figma designs into accessible, responsive experiences while minimizing friction between design and engineering. Create thoughtful animations, haptics, transitions, and micro-interactions that make digital experiences intuitive and engaging. Contribute to and expand a scalable design system with reusable, accessible components across platforms. Take concepts from early ideas and prototypes through implementation, testing, validation, and production release. Develop AI-assisted and agentic workflows that improve design-to-code processes and increase engineering efficiency while maintaining quality standards. Collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and engineers to solve complex interaction and frontend challenges. Advocate for high-quality product craft and identify opportunities to improve usability, performance, accessibility, and overall user experience. Balance attention to detail and product polish with practical delivery needs, making sound decisions about when to refine and when to ship. Requirements Proven experience as a senior frontend or design-focused engineer building and shipping high-traffic, consumer-facing products with React and React Native. Strong proficiency in modern JavaScript and TypeScript, with experience designing scalable cross-platform frontend architectures. Demonstrated expertise in frontend performance, accessibility, reusable UI patterns, and production-quality engineering. A strong portfolio showcasing polished interfaces, interaction design, animations, motion, and micro-interactions rather than static screens alone. Strong understanding of interaction and motion design, with the judgment to use animation and haptics purposefully rather than unnecessarily. Advanced Figma literacy and the ability to interpret design files and translate detailed designs into production-ready code. Experience contributing to or maintaining design systems and reusable component libraries. Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development, agentic workflows, LLM-based tooling, or similar approaches to accelerating software development. Experience with crypto wallets, blockchain, Web3 products, or related technologies is strongly preferred. Strong autonomy, initiative, and judgment, with the ability to work effectively across a globally distributed and asynchronous team. A collaborative mindset and strong communication skills, with the ability to work productively across engineering, design, and product disciplines. Ability to balance technical excellence and design quality with pragmatic delivery and business priorities. Benefits Competitive US base salary ranging from $149,000 to $210,000 USD , excluding bonus, eq

jobgether-jobgether:lever:f95e36a5-9244-.title: Head of Finance
jobgether-jobgether:lever:f95e36a5-9244-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Finance based in South Africa. This is a senior leadership opportunity to build and lead a modern Finance function within a fast-growing international payments environment. You will own management reporting, financial control, budgeting, settlements, cash-flow planning, and financial process optimization. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on ownership of financial models, reporting logic, reconciliations, and operational controls. You will partner closely with Data, Development, Treasury, and executive leadership to turn complex financial information into actionable business insights. A key focus will be replacing manual processes with reliable, automated reporting and scalable financial workflows. You will also oversee financial operations across multiple legal entities, currencies, products, merchants, and payment methods. This role is ideal for an experienced finance leader who thrives on ownership, transformation, and working in a data-driven, international environment. Own end-to-end management reporting, including P&L, Cash Flow Statement, Balance Sheet, plan-vs-actual analysis, and profitability reporting across products, merchants, payment methods, and legal entities. Build and maintain the budgeting and forecasting cycle, including operating budgets, payment calendars, cash-flow forecasts, gap analysis, scenario planning, and obligation tracking. Design and operate a robust financial control framework covering regular reconciliations, discrepancy classification, resolution SLAs, approval workflows, audit trails, and manual adjustment controls. Manage merchant settlements, including settlement calculations, provider fees, minimum fees, surcharges, refunds, chargebacks, FX conversions, and balance transfers. Oversee finance across multiple legal entities, currencies, and intercompany transactions, including consolidated reporting and preparation of information for statutory accounting and external audits. Serve as the business owner for financial automation by defining financial logic, KPIs, formulas, data sources, requirements, and acceptance criteria for dashboards and reports. Collaborate with Data Analysts, Data Engineers, and Development teams to validate financial outputs, identify discrepancies, and prioritize automation initiatives based on business impact. Lead, structure, and develop the Finance team by defining responsibilities, hiring where needed, establishing accountability, and driving continuous process improvement. Report financial performance, risks, forecasts, and business insights to the CEO, founders, and senior leadership in clear, commercially focused language. Establish clear operating boundaries between Finance, Treasury, and Data while maintaining effective collaboration across these functions. Develop a scalable Finance function capable of supporting growth across multiple markets, entities, currencies, and transaction volumes. Requirements 8+ years of experience in Finance, including at least 3 years managing a finance team or function. Professional background in fintech, payments/PSP, acquiring, EMI, banking, crypto payments, or another high-volume transactional business. Proven experience building or transforming financial processes, particularly moving from manual Excel-based reporting toward automated data pipelines and reporting. Strong experience managing multiple legal entities, currencies, and intercompany operations. Hands-on ownership of P&L, Cash Flow, Balance Sheet, plan-vs-actual reporting, and financial forecasting. Ability to define financial metrics, establish standardized calculation methodologies, and develop unit economics and profitability analysis by product, customer, channel, or business line. qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:b91819ed-8de8-44ab.title: Structural Steel Fabrication Supervisor
qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:b91819ed-8de8-44ab.description: Structural Steel Shop Lead Location: Cocoa Beach, FL Job Type: Contract-to-Hire Starting Pay: $30/hour, with higher pay available based on experience Position Overview Seeking an experienced shop lead to coordinate structural steel fabrication activities and support day-to-day production. This hands-on position guides fitters, welders, and fabrication personnel while helping keep work on schedule, meeting quality requirements, and maintaining a safe shop.
responsibilities: Coordinate daily shop activities and help meet production and shipping schedules.
Direct and support structural steel fitters, welders, and fabrication personnel.
Assign work and adjust workloads based on production priorities.
Provide technical support with fit-up, welding, layout, and blueprint interpretation.
Address fabrication problems and production issues as they occur.
Track workflow and communicate production status, delays, and schedule changes.
Enforce safety procedures, quality requirements, and shop policies.
Work with maintenance personnel to minimize equipment downtime.
Coordinate with Quality Control on inspections and fabrication requirements.
Assist with dimensional measurements, inspections, and required documentation.
Help train and onboard employees and support their development.
Keep the shop organized, clean, and safe.
Perform other supervisory and shop duties as needed.
qualifications: 3+ years of experience leading or supervising structural steel fabrication teams.
Strong hands-on knowledge of welding, fit-up, layout, and structural steel fabrication .
Experience using CNC fabrication equipment and shop machinery .
Ability to read and interpret structural steel drawings, blueprints, and fabrication details.
Understanding of workplace safety, quality standards, and production processes.
Strong leadership, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
Willingness to work overtime, weekends, or flexible hours when production requires.

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:a47305f7-19f.title: Senior Project Manager - Contract Research / CRO
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:a47305f7-19f.description: About Welo Life Sciences Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications. welolifesciences.com Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager with a strong background in the Contract Research Organization (CRO) industry to lead and support complex global client programs within a fast-paced and highly regulated environment. In this role, you will manage strategic customer accounts and oversee the successful delivery of projects from initiation through completion, ensuring timelines, quality standards, compliance requirements, and financial objectives are consistently met. You will also collaborate closely with the Operations Squad Lead to support large enterprise and life sciences accounts. The Senior Project Manager will serve as a key point of contact for clients at the project level, partnering cross-functionally with account management, operations, production, quality, and external stakeholders to drive operational excellence, client satisfaction, and long-term partnership success. The ideal candidate brings strong project leadership experience within a CRO, life sciences, clinical research, or regulated healthcare environment, along with exceptional stakeholder management and organizational skills. Job Reference: #LI-JC1 Key Responsibilities Lead the delivery of complex global projects for clients within the contract research, life sciences, or regulated healthcare sectors. Manage the full project lifecycle, including project planning, execution, monitoring, reporting, delivery, and closure. Coordinate cross-functional international teams, including internal departments, vendors, and external stakeholders. Develop project plans, timelines, budgets, forecasts, and resource allocation strategies aligned with client and operational requirements. Ensure projects are delivered in compliance with client expectations, regulatory requirements, SOPs, and quality standards. Identify and mitigate project risks proactively while ensuring timely escalation of critical issues when needed. Partner closely with production, quality, and operations teams to drive continuous process improvements and operational efficiency. Build and maintain strong client relationships, acting as a trusted partner throughout project execution. Provide clear and proactive communication to clients and internal stakeholders regarding timelines, risks, budgets, and project performance. Oversee financial management activities, including budget tracking, invoicing approvals, profitability, and margin management. Prepare client-facing documentation including Statements of Work (SOWs), project plans, process documentation, business reviews, and post-project analyses. Support strategic client initiatives, business reviews, and growth opportunities within enterprise accounts. Contribute to operational best practices, workflow optimization, and process improvement initiatives across the organization. Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Life Sciences, Business, Healthcare, Project Management, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
